review_fixes: Include implicit Drop effects when later aggregate construction exits through try.
Do not infer an exact stdout/stderr match from a truncated prefix.
Derive the required-check policy from the actual requested check IDs.
Run two independent frontend processes as well as two empty-cache backend builds.
Restore source, C, runtime and test-input evidence from retained snapshots.
Require negative sanitizer capability probes; accepted flags and different artifact hashes alone cannot pass.
limits: Audit is required but not implemented; the actual complete reports therefore return not_verified with exit 5.
ASan+UBSan is unsupported on this pinned toolchain because ASan runtime symbols cannot link. TSan and a separate UBSan defect probe were demonstrated.
Toolchain fingerprints bind the installed executable and embedded lock; the full installed archive and compiler-library tree are not content-audited.
Allocation no_alloc uses checked Yavo effects and trusted runtime contracts; startup and uninspected libc/OS internals are outside the function query. Generic template names remain unknown.
Reproducibility was verified for two independent builds of T-N2 with one fixed logical source path, using separate newly created local/global caches; relocation invariance was not tested.
Actual application execution is Linux x86_64. Existing cross-compilation tests cover six targets; Windows/macOS/aarch64 native execution remains unverified.
Windows process cleanup is a bounded taskkill fallback, without a Job Object guarantee for already-orphaned descendants.
Remaining conformance gaps are recorded case by case; no near-C performance claim is established.
